restoration_note: The teaching presents the complete arc: three Great Days (First Man's descent and the Living Spirit's raising; Fathers of Light enthroned in the new aeon; the Father's unveiling in the inmost storehouses) set against two Deaths (temporal mingling ending in the great fire; eternal severance from Light, living Air, and Living Soul). Editor restorations are confirmed where they complete formulaic language: 'new aeon,' 'Father of Greatness,' 'eternity of eternities,' and the recurring nouns 'image,' 'storehouses,' 'fragrance,' 'sweet.' The damaged passage describing the second-death judgment (the woman, the binding in members, the three places) preserves only fragmentary traces of an unfamiliar judicial sequence — the lacunae here (22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 53, 55, 57, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62) are left unrestored rather than invented. {56} restored as ⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ on partial-trace evidence.
